annotation.method: Codex read the complete 21-page manuscript in physical order, including the projection framework, Propositions 2.1 and 3.1-3.4 with their proofs, K-PIK implementation, CF-ADI review, all numerical experiments, appendix code, and all 42 references; separated internally proved results from cited theory and experiments; audited Mathlib and the exact frozen 44-object NumStability surface; and compiled exact private N/L proofs before retaining P48-T3.
annotation.reason: The project owner assigned the P48 source selection and benchmark annotation to Codex.

corpus_membership: This paper is part of the current corpus listed in metadata/manifest.json.

rejected_candidates.reason: The integral formula for the projected Lyapunov solution is called readily established and referred to source [9]. It is cited background rather than a new P48 proof task.
Identifying the displayed Laurent span with K_(2m)(A,A^(-m)B) and proving A K_m is contained in K_(m+1) are direct reindexing arguments, below the substantial tier threshold.

The projected-matrix recurrence is paper-specific but follows by direct substitution into equations (3.3)-(3.4). The frozen library supplies no substantial shortcut, and the resulting coordinate algebra is not as difficult as the retained rank-breakdown theorem.

Their residual-range, residual-norm, and iterate-difference identities are block multiplication plus generic orthogonal norm preservation. No paper-specific substantial NumStability theorem applies, and the proofs remain below the T3 difficulty floor.
Symmetry, positive semidefiniteness, factorized iteration properties, and the residual formula are reviewed from references [25], [28], and [30], not proved as new results here.
These are numerical experiments and implementation observations rather than universal proof tasks.

T1.decision: Skipped. No internally proved P48 result needs one substantial non-Mathlib declaration from the exact compiled NumStability bundle. Generic matrix and orthogonality helpers do not materially replace a paper-specific proof.

T2.decision: Skipped. No source-proved P48 result receives two distinct substantial shortcuts from the exact compiled NumStability surface. Lyapunov/Sylvester developments outside the 44-object bundle are unavailable to L and cannot be counted.

T3.decision: Selected the invariant-subspace conclusion of Proposition 3.4. Exact N/L proofs establish a substantial quotient-dependence, coefficient-case, finite-dimensional rank, and span-invariance argument with no NumStability shortcut.

selection_policy: Use only results and proof content stated in this paper.
Represent the rank-less-than-two premise directly as dependence of the two new directions modulo the old Laurent--Krylov space.
Retain only Proposition 3.4's invariant-subspace conclusion; do not add an invented convergence or error bound.
Do not treat uncompiled Lyapunov/Sylvester source modules as available to condition L.
Assign a tier only after exact private N and L proofs compile.
